title: Social meetings for different age groups
source_note: Original ForLanguage content informed by recurring social-club and face-to-face meeting themes in user-provided review notes; no recalled live-test wording copied.

tasks.prompt: You have joined a local social club. Reply briefly to five member messages.
tasks.review_note: Original practice task based on recurring club-form question type.
questions: What is the weather like today?
How do you usually travel to social events?
Which evening activity do you enjoy?
How often do you meet friends?
What kind of place do you prefer for group meetings?

tasks.prompt: The club wants to help new members get to know one another. Write a short message describing one activity that would make this easier.
tasks.review_note: Original practice task based on recurring short personal-response type.

tasks.prompt: Members are discussing how regular club meetings should be organised.
tasks.review_note: Original practice task focused on reason-giving and comparison.
questions: What time of day would suit most members?
What kind of venue would work well for both younger and older people?
Should every meeting follow the same format? Why or why not?

tasks.prompt: The club plans to replace most informal online chats with regular in-person activity sessions. Write to a friend about your reaction and one idea you would suggest.
tasks.review_note: Original informal email scenario; not a reproduction of a reported live prompt.

tasks.prompt: Write a formal email to the club manager about the new in-person activity sessions. Suggest a suitable schedule and venue, and explain how the club could make the sessions accessible to members with different needs.
tasks.review_note: Original formal email scenario; not a reproduction of a reported live prompt.
